checks.evidence: findings.json at the repo root parses as an array of 12 objects, each with string file, numeric line, a valid severity, string title and string explanation.
Finding 1 'Any signed-in user can read any event's attendee list' at attendees.get.ts:7 says findEventBySlug never checks organizerId, so any signed-in user gets names and emails.

Finding 2 'Event edit spreads the raw request body into the update' at index.patch.ts:12 says the unvalidated readBody result is spread into db.update(events).set(...), so the caller can set organizerId, slug or coverPath.
Finding 3 'The cached event page shows one visitor's RSVP and organizer flag to others' at index.get.ts:33 says getKey uses only the slug while going and isOrganizer depend on userId.
Finding 4 'The signed-in user is kept in a module-scope ref shared by all SSR requests' at useAuth.ts:10 describes the cross-request leak on the server, not just a hydration mismatch.
Finding 5 'The exchange-rates API key is public runtime config and is sent to every browser' at nuxt.config.ts:26 says the key is serialized into every page's payload.
Finding 6 'Open redirect after sign-in through ?redirect= with external: true' at sign-in.vue:21.
Finding 7 'Cover upload accepts SVG and trusts the browser's declared type' at cover.put.ts:20 says image/svg+xml passes ensureBlob and is served from /images on the app's origin, so its script runs.
Finding 8 'Password reset links are built from the request's Host header' at server/auth.ts:11 says requestOrigin || siteUrl lets the Host header win over the configured site URL.
Finding 9 'RSVP checks free seats and inserts in two steps, so events oversell' at rsvp.post.ts:23 describes the race where two concurrent RSVPs both read one seat left and both insert.

Finding 10 'A failed confirmation or reminder email is logged and never retried' at mail.ts:53 (sendRsvpMail) says the error is only logged, the claim stays set and the queue job resolves without a retry.
Finding 11 'Attendee CSV export allows formula injection' at attendees.csv.get.ts:6 says csvField doesn't defuse cells that start with =, +, -, @, tab or CR.
Finding 12 'City filter wraps the column in lower(), so the city index isn't used' at events/index.get.ts:16 says SQLite can't use events_city_starts_at_idx and scans every event.
All 12 matched findings state the effect, e.g. leaked attendee names and emails, the event handed to another user, oversold events, lost confirmation mails, a leaked reset token.

All 12 give the trigger, e.g. GET /api/events/<slug>/attendees, a PATCH with organizerId, Host: evil.example on a reset request, ?redirect=https://evil.example, concurrent RSVPs for the last seat, or a mail-provider outage.

Every fix would work here: findOwnedEvent, readValidatedBody with eventInputSchema, per-user fields outside the cache, useState, a private key behind a cached server route, a same-site path check, an image allowlist with detectContentType, siteUrl first, an atomic conditional insert, clearing the claim and rethrowing, a quote prefix, and COLLATE NOCASE or an expression index. None of them only masks the bug.
Each of the 12 findings matches a different plant, so there is no noise and no real bug outside the rubric's list.
Findings 1-10, the critical and high plants, come before finding 11 (CSV, medium) and finding 12 (index, low).
Every matched finding's severity is the same as its plant's: H1-H5 critical, H6-H10 high, L1 medium, L2 low.
No finding targets server/api/events/index.post.ts; the PATCH finding even cites POST's readValidatedBody as the correct pattern.
The only open-redirect finding is on app/pages/sign-in.vue:21, which really uses external: true; no finding mentions sign-up.vue.
The one finding on server/api/events/index.get.ts (line 16) is about lower(city) defeating the index, not SQL injection in the LIKE clause.
No finding mentions CSRF or missing tokens on the JSON routes.
No finding targets seats.get.ts or calls it missing authentication.
No finding calls findOwnedEvent's 404 wrong; the attendees finding recommends findOwnedEvent so a stranger gets 404.
No finding says the password reset mail must go through the Queue.
No finding mentions requireRateLimit ordering in index.post.ts.
The cover.put.ts finding is about SVG and the declared MIME type (stored XSS), not the blob.del after the swap.
The index.get.ts finding is about the cache key omitting userId (going/isOrganizer), not a hydration mismatch from started.
The cross-request leak finding is on the module-scope ref in app/composables/useAuth.ts; nothing flags useState("locale") in useCurrency.ts.
The only mail.ts finding is at line 53 on sendRsvpMail (plant H10); nothing says sendPasswordReset must throw or retry.
